page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.24xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance built on the x86_64 architecture utilizing the KVM hypervisor. The hardware environment is powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. It provides 96 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standardized compute-optimized ratio of 2.0 GB RAM per vCPU.

Storage and acceleration configurations do not include local NVMe SSDs or discrete GPU units. Persistent storage operations rely entirely on remote block storage solutions. Network connectivity features a high baseline throughput, supporting up to 50 Gbps of network bandwidth. The server configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

By omitting local storage controllers and GPU accelerators, the host configuration minimizes hardware overhead while offering high vCPU density. This structure provides favorable qualitative cost efficiency for execution pipelines requiring heavy multi-core CPU execution. Suitable workloads include distributed software compilation, batch processing, CI/CD build environments, ETL data pipelines, and scalable web serving.
